hero_kpi_rationale: Stable operating margin at 10.5%, reflecting the group's operational discipline in a demanding industrial context. Master KPI for assessing structural profitability despite cost inflation.

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.description: Operating margin reflects operational discipline in a demanding industrial context.

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin is supported by supply chain optimization and pricing.
kpis.signal: High gross margin for an industrial equipment manufacturer.

kpis.name: R&D investments (% revenue)
kpis.explanation: Research and development expenses as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.description: R&D level reflects a model focused on incremental rather than disruptive engineering.
kpis.signal: Moderate R&D, typical for industrial equipment manufacturers.

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the group.
kpis.description: Headcount is growing modestly, supported by activities in emerging markets.

kpis.name: Capital expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on tangible and intangible assets to maintain or expand operations.
kpis.description: Investments are targeted at factory automation and digital transition.
kpis.signal: Moderate CAPEX, oriented toward maintenance and digitalization.

ai_positioning.summary: GEA adopts a cautious approach to artificial intelligence, progressively integrating predictive optimization tools into its engineering solutions, without an aggressive stance on generative AI.
evidence: Mention of digital optimization and digitalization in reporting
No reference to generative AI or large language models in documents
Investments in automation and predictive maintenance
